application_review: A genuine Lie homomorphism on a native Lie subalgebra integrates through the actual graph subgroup. Its first projection is bijective by original exponential injectivity. The resulting group homomorphism has the original exponential formula, is unique with that formula, and is continuous in the inherited subgroup topology.

Every integer input gives a continuous group evaluation on the finite image subgroup. Joint evaluation is injective, and its range is exactly all exponential arrays of the original coefficient Lie algebra. The array subgroup is independent of the finite determining evaluation family.

The actual array range with its inherited pointwise topology is homeomorphic and group-isomorphic to the finite image subgroup. Its inverse coordinates are the selected evaluations. Consequently the actual array group is contractible and simply connected.

For any discrete original subgroup Gamma, the actual all-integer Gamma-valued array subgroup is discrete in its inherited topology. The proof uses a continuous injective map into a finite product of Gamma, and does not assume cocompactness or normality.

Reviewed the graph projection proof: surjectivity uses actual exponential preimages, injectivity uses the original source exponential injectivity. No BCH functoriality or desired multiplication law is assumed.
Reviewed the range characterization and finite-family independence: membership is existence of a single coefficient vector valid at every integer input, not a different vector at each point.
Reviewed the homeomorphism inverse: it is continuous because every finite coordinate is an actual selected evaluation. Both sides use the inherited topologies.

Reviewed discreteness: the finite product of the given discrete Gamma is discrete; selected evaluations separate the actual array subgroup. No compactness, rationality, normality or cocompactness conclusion is smuggled in.

The six pre-existing unregistered continuation modules were reviewed and explicitly rechecked along with four new modules. All baseline source hashes match except the import root and verification registry.

Checks comprise strict per-module Lean elaboration, complete incremental Lake build, and all registered transitive #print axioms reports. No independent checker or fresh isolated build was run in this round.

The actual earlier-variable exposure fixes every residue and slot shift, full own-target numerators and array residues; exact affine tail dependence of each progression and the whole own-target progression sum is proved. Concrete integer-input polynomial array groups, their common nilpotence bound, input translations, pointwise lattice coset evaluation and exact affine model linear orbits are constructed. The genuine original native Lie polynomial-array coefficient algebra, bracket closure, high-degree cutoff and finite dimension are now proved; literal Lie evaluation homomorphisms and their lower-central compatibility are constructed. The same-step lower-central cutoff of the genuine array Lie algebra, injectivity of all integer evaluations and simultaneous coefficient recovery by one fixed finite integer evaluation set are now proved, including for the original native model. The actual binary product native Lie algebra, componentwise original exponential and global logarithm, and integration and inherited topology of every product Lie subalgebra are now proved. The complete native array coefficient algebra now embeds by one fixed finite family of integer inputs into the native Lie algebra of an actual finite original-group product. Its finite evaluation image integrates to a closed contractible simply connected subgroup, uniquely parameterized by coefficient exponentials. All-integer multiplication compatibility, the exact full exponential array subgroup, its group isomorphism and inherited-topology homeomorphism with the finite image, contractibility, simply connectedness, and discreteness of its pointwise Gamma-valued subgroup for discrete Gamma are now proved.
